user.title: Add a TV or media box
user.description: Pick the type of device you want to control.

lg_webos.title: LG WebOS TV
lg_webos.description: Enter the IP/hostname of the TV. MAC is optional but required to turn the TV on when it's fully off (Wake-on-LAN).

pair.title: Pairing with TV
pair.description: Look at the TV at {host} and accept the pairing prompt. Then press SUBMIT here.

error.pair_refused: The TV refused pairing. Accept the prompt on the TV and try again.
error.no_client_key: Pairing succeeded but no client key was returned.

abort.device_type_not_implemented: This device type isn't implemented yet.

init.title: Source preferences
init.description: Pick which sources (HDMI inputs and apps) appear in the media_player picker. Leave empty to show all of them. {note}
